evals.expected_output:
Entering SDD orchestration for the change: "catalog eval harness".

Preflight (blocking, before sdd-init): ask the user the execution mode — auto or interactive. No silent default; no phase is launched without an explicit answer.
DAG: proposal -> specs/design -> tasks -> apply -> verify -> archive (design branches from proposal).
Plan: sdd-init (stack + testing capabilities) -> sdd-explore -> (sdd-research if chosen) -> sdd-propose -> sdd-spec + sdd-design -> sdd-tasks -> sdd-apply -> sdd-verify -> sdd-archive.
Delegation: every phase runs in a fresh sub-agent; this orchestrator routes and synthesizes — it does not run the phases inline.
Gatekeeper (auto): one corrective re-run of the SAME phase; a SECOND failure stops the chain and escalates both attempts — automatic retries stop at two.

evals.prompt: sdd continue with the next phase of the change
evals.expected_output:
Continuing the active SDD change: resolve the next dependency-ready phase from the DAG (proposal -> specs/design -> tasks -> apply -> verify -> archive) and launch exactly that phase in a fresh sub-agent.

Interactive mode: show the phase result summary, then wait for explicit approval. One "continue" approves only the immediate next phase — not the rest of the pipeline. A generated artifact is not considered approved until the user reviewed it or delegated that review.

Gatekeeper failure: re-run the SAME phase once with corrective feedback naming the gate findings; a SECOND failure stops the chain and escalates both attempts plus the recommended fix — automatic retries stop at two.
expectations: contains:approves only the immediate next phase
